company.name: KarmSolar
company.shortDescription: KarmSolar is a private off-grid solar energy integrator in Egypt.
company.description:
The company is an owner of a transdisciplinary utility platform designed to create solar energy for a variety of businesses and neighborhoods.

Through developing unique approaches to each project, we develop systems that harness the power of the sun and replace diesel-powered processes and thereby producing energy that is affordable, stable, reliable, and environmentally friendly.

KarmSolar was established on October 23, 2011 by Ahmed Zahran and Tamer Essawy in Cairo, Al Qahirah.

productsAndServices.description: Solar power stations designed, owned, and operated by KarmSolar provide businesses with renewable energy either connected to the national grid or functioning independently without upfront investment.
productsAndServices.name: Solar Power Generation Stations

productsAndServices.description: KarmSolar supplies electricity through private distribution networks in urban and remote areas, managing infrastructure, metering, billing, and customer support for commercial and residential developments.
productsAndServices.name: Private Power Distribution Networks

productsAndServices.description: Micro-grids are off-grid energy systems combining solar PV, battery storage, and diesel generators to provide reliable electricity to businesses and communities in remote areas.
productsAndServices.name: Micro-grids

productsAndServices.description: KarmWater offers solar-powered desalination plants that provide clean freshwater to businesses in remote or water-scarce areas under Water Purchase Agreements without upfront client investment.
productsAndServices.name: KarmWater Solar-Powered Water Desalination

productsAndServices.description: KarmCharge develops and operates electric vehicle charging stations integrated into commercial and public locations across Egypt, leveraging KarmSolar’s electricity distribution network.
